citations.quote: If an index consistently appears in either the first or fourth quartile, it is likely to indicate a problem with the benchmark, not with the managers.
we would expect the beta of the average manager characteristic line regression relative to the style index to be closer to 1.0, the standard error closer to zero, and the R-squared closer to 1.00.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Statistical tests confirming a candidate benchmark fits a manager or style universe: regress manager returns on the benchmark and check beta toward 1, standard error toward 0, R-squared toward 1, plus a quartile/box-chart median-proximity test.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Benchmark-Quality Validation Statistics
